api_surface: PydanticAI Agent (primary): Agent graph (agent.iter nodes), FunctionModel offline seam, framework message/part model (ModelRequest/ModelResponse/parts), NativeOutput structured strategy, approval-required/deferred tools (DeferredToolRequests), run_stream_events framework events, RunUsage aggregation, ModelResponse.model_name identity, framework terminal states, framework exception hierarchy. The low-level direct API is NOT the primary surface.
boundary: PydanticAI Agent ONLY. This lane does NOT audit the Pydantic AI Gateway, Pydantic Evals, Pydantic Graph as a standalone product, MCP servers, durable-execution integrations, Logfire, OpenTelemetry export, or provider-native semantics. No custom provider endpoint is configured and no Router/FallbackModel is used.

claimed_feature_support.note: PydanticAI Agent operations implemented in this probe. A framework operation succeeding OFFLINE says nothing about live provider semantics or model support; both remain UNVERIFIED until a live run (DevSpec Section 55). PydanticAI's framework-owned behavior (message/part model, output-strategy selection, validation, deferred-tool handling, usage aggregation, stream events, graph nodes, terminal states, exceptions) is the audit subject, not a capability claim.
claimed_feature_support.roles: framework_operation_implemented (system message -> Agent instructions -> framework InstructionPart; distinguished from provider-native system instructions)
claimed_feature_support.structured_output: framework_operation_implemented (NativeOutput selected explicitly via a SYNTHETIC model profile advertising supports_json_schema_output; output_mode observed 'native'; generated JSON Schema + framework parse/validate recorded; NO silent fallback to ToolOutput/PromptedOutput)
claimed_feature_support.tools: framework_operation_implemented (approval-required tool via ApprovalRequiredToolset; one ToolCallPart emitted; run output = DeferredToolRequests; tool body NOT executed; model invocations = 1, second model turn = 0)
claimed_feature_support.streaming: framework_operation_implemented (run_stream_events framework event lifecycle: PartStartEvent/PartDeltaEvent/PartEndEvent/FinalResultEvent/AgentRunResultEvent; graph nodes captured separately via agent.iter)
claimed_feature_support.usage: framework_operation_implemented (ModelResponse RequestUsage [fixture_expected offline] kept distinct from Agent RunUsage aggregation [framework_native]; absent stays absent, never 0)
claimed_feature_support.errors: framework_operation_implemented (PydanticAI exception hierarchy captured as evidence; DeferredToolRequests is a terminal state, NOT an error)

framework_boundary_notes: PydanticAI's Agent output (messages, parts, usage aggregation, model_name, terminal states, exceptions) is FRAMEWORK-owned (framework_native). Framework message parts are NEVER labelled provider-native, even when a value resembles a provider's.

The only model used offline is FunctionModel (PydanticAI's own explicit-control test seam). ALLOW_MODEL_REQUESTS is set False before any Agent runs, and a network tripwire blocks sockets. TestModel is deliberately NOT the primary evidence generator (it auto-synthesizes schema-valid data and auto-calls tools, hiding framework behavior).

The offline FunctionModel exposes a SYNTHETIC model_name distinct from the requested model, so requested != observed is recorded (model_identity_match=false), non-failing, with offline source fixture_expected. The requested model is never copied into the observed field.

NativeOutput native structured-output support is advertised by a SYNTHETIC offline model profile (supports_json_schema_output=True) set by the probe, NOT inferred from any real provider. Offline this proves only that PydanticAI selected NativeOutput, generated the schema, prepared native-output request parameters, passed them to FunctionModel, and parsed/validated the synthetic response; a real provider accepting/following native JSON schema is unverified_until_live.

Full logfire and the OpenTelemetry SDK/exporter are NOT installed (only the inert logfire-api and opentelemetry-api interface shims are present as transitive dependencies), so no telemetry can leave the process. Provider model integrations (openai/anthropic/google) require vendor SDKs that are absent in this slim install, so a real provider model cannot be constructed.
known_limitations: No live evidence exists yet; all P0.7B verification is offline via PydanticAI's own FunctionModel seam, which runs the real Agent graph, message/part model, output-strategy selection, validation, deferred-tool handling, usage aggregation, and stream events without the network.

Real provider request shape/headers/routing/alias resolution/structured-output adherence/tool-call selection/retry behavior/streaming behavior/usage accuracy/error taxonomy from a network response stay unverified_until_live.

Output-validation retries, tool retries, and per-tool retries are all zero, and a one-model-request usage limit is applied; the Pydantic AI Gateway is never used and Logfire/OpenTelemetry export is never enabled.
The probe emits raw evidence and a minimal manifest only; normalization is a harness stage.
run_stream_events and agent.iter are two DISTINCT single-request exercises of the stream fixture (framework events vs graph nodes); neither is a retry of the other.
